Every pin gets a glyph.

Category icons now render inside every map marker and legend swatch on the events map, so 1-Day, 4-hour, Group Sitting and Virtual Group Sitting are distinguishable beyond color alone. Below: the shipped geometry running live, screenshots from the real map, and the tests holding it in place.

01The shipped pins, running live

These are not mockups — the SVG paths, colors and sizing below are lifted verbatim from lib/icons.tsx, lib/colors.ts and map-marker.tsx. Drag the zoom slider: diameter, border and glyph re-derive with the exact whole-pixel parity math the component ships.

02On the real map

Captured from the running app (bun dev, Chromium via Playwright, geolocation granted at Paris — the same steering the nearby-events e2e uses, so the map recenters itself instead of blind zooming).

Paris, zoomed by the app itself. Group Sitting pins (navy, people glyph) cluster on the city; a 1-Day pin (gold, sun glyph) sits east near Sézanne. The nearest event is auto-selected — bigger pin, info window — and the nearby-events strip fills in below the map.
Close-up, 2× device pixels. Glyphs stay centered in the pin — the whole-pixel parity fix is what keeps them from drifting up-left in WebKit at these sizes.
Legend swatches match the pins. Each toggle carries the same icon as its markers, so the legend is the key to the map in both senses.

03What holds it in place

Shipped as a1b6a821 on PR #488 (branch todo-148-150-maps-v3), CI green.

✓
Marker geometry map-marker.test.tsx
Diameter, border and glyph land on whole pixels with matching parity at every zoom level and selection state — the invariant behind the centering fix (5c275ca5).
✓
Icon-per-pin wiring map-content.test.tsx
Every rendered marker carries its category's icon and color; data-category-id is the contract the e2e selectors ride on.
✓
Live-map sweep icon-markers.e2e.ts
Against the running app: every legend toggle has an icon swatch, and zero pins render without an SVG glyph — a category that loses its icon fails the build, not the user.
✓
Environment skip-ladder
Specs skip cleanly when the route isn't deployed or Google Maps can't load, so they're safe on every CI target while still biting on the ones that matter.
